about_the_game:
Introduction:

"Corpse" is set in a Hong Kong family and tells the story of the differences in values between two generations due to social circumstances.

"Corpse" is a horror game set in Hong Kong in the 1970s. Players can learn about Hong Kong culture during the game.

About the Game:

"Corpse" is set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, with the Kowloon Walled City as its core setting. Players can immerse themselves in the environment of the Kowloon Walled City at that time. Through the linear storyline, players can experience the rich atmosphere of Hong Kong and the daily lives of the residents at that time.

Story Background:

The story tells the story of a young man, Jiahao, who is led by a strange force to a renovated historic district. A series of strange events occur, and upon arriving, Jiahao feels a sense of nausea and wants to escape as quickly as possible. Meanwhile, in the real world, the number of missing persons continues to rise...

Game Features:

Set in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City, the game incorporates a story of the differences in values between two generations due to social circumstances, allowing players to experience the feelings of the residents of the Kowloon Walled City at that time as they faced the impending demolition.

──Adventure──

The world offers various spaces for players to explore, and the various items they obtain will help unravel the story's storyline.

──Puzzle──

The game features mini-levels inspired by various Hong Kong cultural periods and customs, allowing the story to progress smoothly.

──Enemy──

Players will face a primary enemy that relentlessly pursues the protagonist, and the player must find a way to escape it. The reason for its relentless pursuit is undoubtedly a fascinating story...

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel/AMD
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: "Missing" is a first-person horror adventure game set in 1970s Hong Kong. The story follows a young man named Jiahao, who is led by a mysterious force into a renovated historic district. A series of strange events unfold, and upon arriving, Jiahao feels a nausea and longs to escape.
